title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Solid Brass Hardware Bathroom Storage | Golden Yellow | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized, space-saving storage to your bathroom with this wall mount glass shelf featuring three tiers and solid brass hardware in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. Designed to coordinate within the Carolina Collection, it complements transitional bathroom hardware and works well with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Thick, beveled-edge glass with solid brass hardware
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished installation
